prompt_template.system: You are a biomedical expert. Answer '$' or '~' only.
prompt_template.human:
{text}
You are an expert of biomedical domain, above article is a biomedical paper.
Refer to above biomedical article, you need review the entire article to judge:
1. {head} and {tail} are different {entity_type}, answer '~'
2. {head} and {tail} are same {entity_type}, {head} is a narrower concept than {tail}, answer '~'
3. {head} and {tail} are same {entity_type},{head} is a broader concept than {tail}, answer '$'
Do not output any other message
